title: Sing for your health!
paragraphs: Whether you love to belt out tunes at karaoke or just sing in the shower, it turns out that singing can be good for both physical and mental health. And you don't even have to be good at it!

The physical and mental advantages of singing are caused by a combination of factors, according to Baishali Mukherjee from the World Federation of Music Therapy. He told BBC Future, "The physical exertion involved in singing – filling of our lungs, the firm control of our vocal cords, the movements of our mouth and body – is among the reasons why it can boost our mood." Hitting all the notes involves breathing control and the use of the diaphragm. This can lead to an increase of oxygen intake and lung capacity.

Also, apparently, singing in a group brings just as many benefits as singing solo. It has been estimated that over 2.2 million people in Britain now regularly sing in a choir. A choir can be amateur or professional and is made up of people who sing together, often in harmony with different people singing different parts, such as soprano or tenor, according to their vocal range.

A 2022 University of Vienna study found that choral singing enhances feelings of trust and bonding among a group, which can help with depression and loneliness. And, aside from mood-boosting, other proven mental health benefits of singing include a lowering of stress and anxiety levels due to the release of endorphins – the so-called "happy hormones".

So, whether you are a confident vocalist or not, give singing a go! You don't need an instrument because that's you. And yes, you might forget the lyrics or sound a little out of tune, but remember, there are a wealth of positives.

vocabulary.entry: belt out tunes /belt aʊt tjuːn/ 放声高歌；大声唱曲子
vocabulary.example: She likes to belt out tunes while she's cooking in the kitchen.
vocabulary.translation: 她喜欢在厨房做饭时放声高歌。

vocabulary.entry: karaoke /ˌkæriˈəʊki/ n. 卡拉OK；卡拉OK演唱
vocabulary.example: We booked a private room at the karaoke for my friend's birthday.
vocabulary.translation: 我们为朋友的生日在卡拉OK订了一个包间。

vocabulary.entry: combination /ˌkɒmbɪˈneɪʃn/ n. 结合；组合；混合因素
vocabulary.example: The team's success comes from a combination of hard work and good strategy.
vocabulary.translation: 这支队伍的成功源于努力和优秀策略的结合。

vocabulary.entry: music therapy /ˈmjuːzɪk ˈθerəpi/ 音乐疗法
vocabulary.example: Music therapy is used to help people cope with emotional and physical stress.
vocabulary.translation: 音乐疗法被用于帮助人们应对情绪和身体上的压力。

vocabulary.entry: physical exertion /ˈfɪzɪkl ɪɡˈzɜːʃn/ 体力消耗；身体活动量
vocabulary.example: This job requires a lot of physical exertion and not just mental work.
vocabulary.translation: 这份工作需要大量的体力付出，而不只是脑力劳动。

vocabulary.entry: lung /lʌŋ/ n. 肺；肺部
vocabulary.example: Regular exercise can help keep your lung in good condition.
vocabulary.translation: 规律运动有助于保持肺部健康。

vocabulary.entry: vocal cord /ˈvəʊkl kɔːd/ n. 声带
vocabulary.example: Rest is important for a damaged vocal cord to heal properly.
vocabulary.translation: 声带受损后，休息对其正常恢复至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: boost /buːst/ v. 提升；促进；增强
vocabulary.example: A cup of tea can boost your energy when you feel tired.
vocabulary.translation: 感到疲惫时，一杯茶能为你补充精力。

vocabulary.entry: note /nəʊt/ n. 音符；音调；音高
vocabulary.example: He hit a high note at the end of the song that surprised everyone.
vocabulary.translation: 他在歌曲结尾唱出了一个高音，让所有人都感到意外。

vocabulary.entry: breathing control /ˈbriːðɪŋ kənˈtrəʊl/ 呼吸控制；调息
vocabulary.example: Breathing control is a basic skill that all singers need to learn.
vocabulary.translation: 呼吸控制是所有歌手都需要学习的基础技能。

vocabulary.entry: diaphragm /ˈdaɪəfræm/ n. 膈；横膈膜
vocabulary.example: Using the diaphragm correctly helps singers produce a stronger voice.
vocabulary.translation: 正确运用横膈膜能帮助歌手唱出更有力的声音。

vocabulary.entry: oxygen intake /ˈɒksɪdʒən ˈɪnteɪk/ 摄氧量；氧气吸入量
vocabulary.example: Deep breathing can increase your oxygen intake and calm your nerves.
vocabulary.translation: 深呼吸能提升你的摄氧量，平复情绪。

vocabulary.entry: lung capacity /ˈlʌŋ kəˈpæsəti/ 肺活量
vocabulary.example: Swimming is a great sport to improve your lung capacity.
vocabulary.translation: 游泳是提升肺活量的绝佳运动。

vocabulary.entry: solo /ˈsəʊləʊ/ adv. 独自地；单独地 n. 独唱；独奏
vocabulary.example: The musician played a piano solo that brought the audience to tears.
vocabulary.translation: 这位音乐家的钢琴独奏让观众热泪盈眶。

vocabulary.entry: choir /ˈkwaɪə(r)/ n. 合唱团；唱诗班
vocabulary.example: She joined the local choir to meet people who love singing.
vocabulary.translation: 她加入了当地的合唱团，结识志同道合的歌唱爱好者。

vocabulary.entry: amateur /ˈæmətə(r)/ adj. 业余的；非专业的 n. 业余爱好者
vocabulary.example: He is an amateur painter who paints in his free time.
vocabulary.translation: 他是一位业余画家，利用业余时间作画。

vocabulary.entry: harmony /ˈhɑːməni/ n. 和声；和谐；融洽
vocabulary.example: The four singers sang in perfect harmony during the performance.
vocabulary.translation: 四位歌手在演出中唱出了完美的和声。

vocabulary.entry: soprano /səˈprɑːnəʊ/ n. 女高音；女高音歌手 adj. 女高音的
vocabulary.example: The soprano has a clear voice that suits classical music perfectly.
vocabulary.translation: 这位女高音的嗓音清亮，十分适合演唱古典音乐。

vocabulary.entry: tenor /ˈtenə(r)/ n. 男高音；男高音歌手；音域
vocabulary.example: He has a natural tenor voice and was asked to join the choir.
vocabulary.translation: 他天生拥有男高音嗓音，被邀请加入了合唱团。

vocabulary.entry: vocal range /ˈvəʊkl reɪndʒ/ 音域；歌唱音域
vocabulary.example: Her wide vocal range allows her to sing both high and low songs.
vocabulary.translation: 她宽广的音域让她既能唱高音也能唱低音歌曲。

vocabulary.entry: choral singing /ˈkɔːrəl ˈsɪŋɪŋ/ 合唱；集体歌唱
vocabulary.example: Choral singing is a popular activity for people of all ages in this town.
vocabulary.translation: 合唱是这个小镇上各个年龄段的人都喜爱的活动。

vocabulary.entry: bonding /ˈbɒndɪŋ/ n. 建立亲密关系；情感联结
vocabulary.example: Shared activities are a great way to encourage bonding among team members.
vocabulary.translation: 共同的活动是促进团队成员间情感联结的好方法。

vocabulary.entry: endorphin /enˈdɔːfɪn/ n. 内啡肽
vocabulary.example: Laughing can trigger the release of endorphin in the human body.
vocabulary.translation: 大笑能促进人体内啡肽的分泌。

vocabulary.entry: vocalist /ˈvəʊkəlɪst/ n. 歌手；声乐表演者
vocabulary.example: The band is looking for a new vocalist with a unique singing style.
vocabulary.translation: 这支乐队正在寻找一位演唱风格独特的新歌手。

vocabulary.entry: lyric /ˈlɪrɪk/ n. 歌词；抒情诗 adj. 抒情的
vocabulary.example: I love this song because its lyric is full of warm feelings about home.
vocabulary.translation: 我喜欢这首歌，因为它的歌词充满了对家的温情。

vocabulary.entry: out of tune /aʊt ɒv tjuːn/ 走调；跑调；音调不准
vocabulary.example: He was so nervous that he sang out of tune at the start of the show.
vocabulary.translation: 他太紧张了，演出一开始就唱跑调了。

sentences.chinese: 他在接受BBC未来频道采访时说：“唱歌时的身体活动——充盈肺部、稳定控制声带、嘴巴和身体的协调动作——都是它能改善我们心情的原因之一。”

sentences.english: Hitting all the notes involves breathing control and the use of the diaphragm. This can lead to an increase of oxygen intake and lung capacity.
sentences.chinese: 唱准每一个音符需要控制呼吸并运用横膈膜，这会增加氧气摄入量，提升肺活量。

sentences.chinese: 并且，似乎合唱和独唱带来的益处不相上下。

sentences.chinese: 维也纳大学2022年的一项研究发现，合唱能增强群体成员之间的信任感和凝聚力，这有助于缓解抑郁和孤独感。

sentences.chinese: 除了改善心情之外，唱歌对心理健康的其他经证实的益处还包括：唱歌会促使分泌内啡肽——即所谓的“快乐荷尔蒙”，从而降低压力和焦虑水平。

sentences.english: So, whether you are a confident vocalist or not, give singing a go!
sentences.chinese: 所以，无论对于唱歌是否自信，你都不妨试试！

sentences.chinese: 你不需要任何乐器，因为你自己就是乐器。

sentences.chinese: 没错，你可能会忘词，也可能会跑调，但请记住，唱歌带来的好处数不胜数。
